2609.29363.title: Beyond Simple Input-Output Assessment Tasks: Leveraging Automated Programming Assessment for Non-Trivial Courses
2609.29363.paper_summary: The public visibility of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is growing rapidly, driven by the positive impact of its applications across diverse fields of knowledge. In this new chapter, courses that cover the foundations of AI and machine learning become essential for understanding their role and potential in contemporary society. Therefore, understanding fundamental concepts and elementary algorithms through the close integration of theory with practice is essential in AI courses. In this essay, we report our experience designing machine learning exercises for automated assessment tools in programming. It is worth mentioning that we are not developing a novel form of automated grading system. Instead, we propose a perspective that frames machine learning problems as input-output assessment tasks. From this perspective, each exercise admits a unique and deterministic answer and enables automated programming assessment tools (e.g., VPL for Moodle, Codeforces, and MOJ) to effectively support AI education. We believe this essay can encourage instructors to foster educational innovation by adopting more dynamic and interactive approaches to AI courses that integrate theory and practice. Importantly, this essay does not introduce an innovation in the use of AI for education; rather, it introduces an innovative approach to improving the learning of AI, particularly, machine learning.
2609.29363.paper_summary_zh: 人工智慧（AI）的公共能見度正在迅速增長，這是由於其在各個知識領域應用的正面影響。在這個新篇章中，涵蓋AI和機器學習基礎的課程對於理解它們在當代社會中的角色和潛力變得至關重要。因此，通過理論與實踐的緊密結合來理解基本概念和初步算法，在AI課程中是必不可少的。在這篇文章中，我們報告了設計自動評估工具的機器學習練習的經驗。值得一提的是，我們並不是在開發一種新型的自動評分系統。相反，我們提出了一種將機器學習問題框架化為輸入-輸出評估任務的視角。從這個角度來看，每個練習都有一個獨特且確定的答案，並使自動編程評估工具（例如，Moodle的VPL、Codeforces和MOJ）能夠有效支持AI教育。我們相信這篇文章可以鼓勵教師通過採用更具動態性和互動性的方式，來促進AI課程的教育創新，並整合理論與實踐。重要的是，這篇文章並未在教育中引入AI的創新；而是介紹了一種創新的方法來改善AI的學習，特別是機器學習。
